QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Ellin, the Friend of Elves
QuestInfo.0: Go and ask #bEllin#k in #bDeep Fairy Forest#k for the fruit.
QuestInfo.1:
Ellin has many things on her mind, but is being annoyed by the noisy monsters nearby. She said she'll give you the fruit if you can defeat the monsters.
Talk to Ellin after defeating #b50#k each of #bAncient Fairy#k and #bShining Fairy#k in #bFairy Forest 1#k.
QuestInfo.2: Ellin was lost in thought after giving you the fruit. What is she worrying about?

default.0: It's still noisy. Did you do what I asked? Defeat the monsters in #bFairy Forest 1#k.
